title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Lemon Cola
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kit Only Replenish your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K vape kit with the Lemon Cola Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. This convenient replacement pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an 8ml refill container, both filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid in a sharply refreshing soda blend. Lemon Cola pairs the rich, caramel depth of traditional Cola with a sharp, zesty twist of fresh Lemon. The citrus bite perfectly cuts through the sweet soda base, creating a highly balanced and refreshing vape experience. Each pod and refill pack is designed for the Dojo Blast 10K device, while also being fully compatible with the Vaporesso Dojo Blast 30K prefilled pod kit. Offering up to 10,000 puffs* per pack, it is powered by Vaporesso's dual mesh coil and COREX 2.0 technology. The transparent pod design makes it easy to track your e-liquid levels, while the Smart Liq-Cycle system ensures steady coil saturation for consistently excellent flavour. *Puff count is an estimate and depends on the length of draw on each use.
